Entries.Text: Only Elden Ring has forbidden region (.mfr) files.

Creates and edits a map's forbidden region boxes (its .mfr file). Inside a Save Limit box the game won't save the player's position; inside a Multiplay Limit box multiplayer is limited. The boxes are saved with the map.
Which boxes the viewport draws, and their colours. The same settings as the forbidden region toggle in the Map List header.
Draws the boxes of every loaded map (of the types ticked below). While editing in the viewport the selected box is drawn even when this is off.
Pick, move, rotate and scale boxes in the viewport.

While on, the box under the cursor is outlined and a click selects it, and the gizmo moves, rotates or scales the selected box. A click on no box selects map objects as usual. Turns itself off while this tool isn't shown.
Click on a surface in the viewport to place the new box.
The gizmo is on the selected box. Its size is scaled along the box's own axes in Local gizmo space.
The map whose boxes are edited. Selecting an object of another map, or clicking one of its boxes, switches to it.
Load a map to edit its forbidden regions.
Creates an empty forbidden region file for this map, with the grid the game's empty files use (256 m centred on the map). Adding a box creates one too.
Grid: depth {0}, half size {1:0.##} m, centre X {2:0.##} Z {3:0.##}
{0} boxes reach past the grid. The game still finds them, but less efficiently; Fit Grid to Boxes covers them.
The map's boxes, by index, type and centre (map space).
Click a box to select it; double-click to frame it in the viewport.
Lists only boxes of this type.
The selected box. Each change is one undoable edit, made when the input is left.
Save Limit: the player's position isn't saved inside the box. Multiplay Limit: multiplayer is limited inside the box.
The centre of the box in map space, like an MSB position.
The full size of the box along its own X, Y and Z axes, in metres (the file stores half of it).
In degrees, in the same convention as MSB rotations, so an object's rotation can be copied in.
This box's axes are mirrored (as some of the game's are). Edits keep the mirror.
Quadtree cell: {0} (recomputed on every edit and on save)
Adds a box of the type below to the current map.
Click on a surface in the viewport: a 4 m box is placed standing on it. Turns on Edit in Viewport.
Forbidden Region Editor: nothing was under the click.
Adds a 4 m box 10 m in front of the camera.
Adds a box around the drawn bounds of the selected objects of the current map (axis aligned in map space).
Moves the viewport's camera to the box.
Adds a copy of the box beside it, along its X axis, and selects it.
Aligns the box with the map's axes.
The quadtree the game files the boxes in, so it can find the boxes near the player.
Centres the grid on the boxes and sizes it to cover them all, then refiles every box. Keeps the grid's depth.
Add forbidden region box around selection in {0}
